description: SignalBrief M3 test cases. Offline cases (O*) test MCP tool parsing, the citation guardrail, coverage memory, both handoffs, fact-check verdict handling, the tool budget and the ReAct trace with saved sample data - no API key needed (O5 needs Chroma's local embedding model, downloaded once). Live cases (L*) run the 3-agent pipeline against NRP + the real MCP tools; because news changes daily, their expected outputs are properties of the result, not exact text.

offline.name: News tool filters old items and duplicates
offline.expected_output: 2 articles (Arturia 2026-09-29 first, then Serum 2026-09-28); the duplicate Serum headline and the 2026-08-31 story are removed; ' - Source' suffix stripped from titles; each has a ref starting with 'n-'.

offline.name: Music tool keeps only recent, exactly-dated releases
offline.expected_output: 2 releases: 'Brand New Single' (Single, 2026-09-20) and 'Live Set' (Album / Live, 2026-09-10). The 2024 album and the year-only '2026' EP are excluded.

offline.name: PubMed parser builds PubMed links
offline.expected_output: 2 papers; first url is https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40000001/, journal 'The Lancet Oncology', published '2026-09-27'; second falls back to the short journal name 'Nat Commun'.

offline.name: Citation guardrail drops invented sources
offline.input: Agent text with 3 bullets: one citing a real ref, one citing a ref that no tool returned (n-fffff), one with no citation at all.
offline.expected_output: Only the first bullet survives, rewritten with a real markdown link '[MusicRadar, 2026-09-28](https://...)'; stats = kept 1, dropped 2, bad_refs 1.

offline.name: Coverage memory recognizes repeats (ChromaDB)
offline.input: Empty memory; remember the Serum 2 story under topic 'New VST plugins'. Then look up: (a) same URL, (b) a re-worded Serum 2 headline from another outlet, (c) an unrelated Arturia headline, (d) the Serum headline under a different topic, (e) the same URL with sent_on 60 days ago.
offline.expected_output: (a) match 'same_url'; (b) match 'same_story' with cosine distance <= 0.35; (c) no match; (d) no match (memory is per topic); (e) no match (outside the 30-day window).

offline.name: Handoff 1 (Scout -> Editor) is built from real tool records
offline.input: Scout answer selecting [Arturia ref], [n-fffff] (never returned by a tool) and [Serum ref] (already in memory); plus a second Scout answer 'NONE'.
offline.expected_output: Packet: 1 candidate (Arturia), 1 already_covered (Serum), invented_refs ['n-fffff']; handoff triggers; the Editor input contains no URLs and no covered item. For 'NONE': 0 candidates and the handoff does not trigger.

offline.name: Handoff 2 + fact-check verdicts are applied in code
offline.input: 4 Editor bullets (one written without a '- ' marker) and a FactCheckReport: id0 supported, id1 overstated with a revision that lost its [ref], id2 unsupported, id3 no verdict.
offline.expected_output: split_bullets keeps the dash-less line; the request attaches each bullet's cited records; result keeps 3 bullets: original id0, revised id1 with its ref restored, id3 kept as unchecked; id2 dropped; stats supported 1 / overstated 1 / unsupported 1 / unchecked 1.

offline.name: Tool budget is enforced by the MCP tool filter
offline.input: ToolBudget(max_source_calls=3, max_memory_calls=1); record recall_coverage once and search_news three times.
offline.expected_output: Before: all tools visible. After: recall_coverage, search_news, search_research_papers and get_artist_releases are hidden; an unrelated tool stays visible.

offline.name: ReAct trace groups Thought -> Action -> Observation
offline.input: Simplified run items: thought, action recall_coverage, observation (0 already sent), thought, action search_news, observation (wrapped JSON with 2 articles), answer.
offline.expected_output: 3 steps: step 1 and 2 each have thought + action + observation ('0 already sent', '2 articles'); step 3 is the answer.

live.name: News topic - full 3-agent pipeline
live.expected_output: Scout calls recall_coverage then search_news, <= 3 source calls; if handoff 1 fires, the Editor and Fact-checker both run, every published bullet has a verdict (unchecked = 0) and a working link; bad_refs = 0. Otherwise exactly '_No notable updates in this window._'.

live.name: Artist topic - tool budget holds (M2 L2 failure)
live.expected_output: Scout calls get_artist_releases; source tool calls <= 3 (M2 made 4-6); bad_refs = 0; any release bullet links to musicbrainz.org.

live.name: Research topic - PubMed first
live.expected_output: The first source tool the Scout calls is search_research_papers; bad_refs = 0; published bullets were all fact-checked.

live.name: Nonsense topic - must not hallucinate
live.expected_output: Tools return no records; handoff 1 does not trigger; section is exactly '_No notable updates in this window._' with 0 kept bullets.

live.name: Memory - day 2 does not repeat day 1
live.input: Run the L1 topic twice in a row against the same empty temporary memory, writing memory after each run.
live.expected_output: No source URL published in run 1 is published again in run 2; memory count after run 1 equals the number of sources published in run 1.

live.name: Fact-checker catches an overstated claim
live.input: Fact-checker only, 2 seeded bullets citing the headline 'Baby Keem announces new album Ca$ino, previews collaboration with Kendrick Lamar': (0) adds 'the top-selling track of the week' (the M2 failure); (1) a faithful paraphrase.
live.expected_output: Bullet 0 verdict is 'overstated' or 'unsupported'; bullet 1 verdict is 'supported'.
